out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED A KNIFE IN THE HANDWASHING SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: KNIFE REMOVED. PIC RE-EDUCATED. MAIN STREET BAGEL DELI (Inspection Date: 08/28/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED IN (5): OATMILK AT 47F (OVERNIGHT) OBSERVED IN SELF SERVE THERMOS: MILK AT 51F (2.5HR)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: OATMILK DISPOSED OF, AND MILK PUT IN COOLER TO COOL DOWN.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restriction & Storage; Medicines Location
violations.observation: OBSERVED EMPLOYEE EYE DROPS STORED WITH COFFEE FLAVORING IN THE COFFEE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Employees' medicines shall be properly stored to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. CDI: EYE DROPS RELOCATED.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Cooling in Equipment
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: OBSERVED EGG AND CHICKEN SALAD COOLING FROM PREP IN (9) WHILE TIGHTLY COVERED IN TO-GO CONTAINERS. OBSERVED COOKED EGG COOLING IN THE WALK-IN COOLER WHILE THICKLY STACKED AND COVERED.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. CDI: ITEMS IMPROPERLY COOLING WERE PLACED IN SHALLOW PANS AND PUT IN THE FREEZER TO PROPERLY COOL.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Lockers, Provided
violations.observation: Lockers or other suitable facilities are not provided for employees clothing and other possessions.
violations.corrective_action: Provide proper storage facilities for employees' personal belongings to prevent contamination of food, food equipment, and food contact surfaces. OBSERVED NO AREA FOR EMPLOYEES TO STORE THEIR PERSONAL ITEMS. PLEASE INSTALL LOCKERS OR SIMILAR FOR EMPLOYEES TO STORE THEIR ITEMS TO PREVENT CONTAMINATION. PLEASE CORRECT THIS BY YOUR NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION IN FEBRUARY.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events during the time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS provided a copy of the cleanup poster to PIC

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 2 door glass sliding display case (2 in report) and 2 door prep top used for storing salad dressing ( 4 in report)
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: door frame to the Walk in freezer in coming off the walk in freezer structure.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. Person in charge agreed to have the walk in freezer repaired

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. EHS OBSERVED BOXES OF CANNED AND BOTTLED DRINKS AND CHIPS STORED ON FLOOR OF DINING ROOM AND DOORWAY.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PIC WILL OBTAIN SUFFICIENT, APPROVED STORAGE FOR ALL FOOD ITEMS. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE YOUR NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Smooth, Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not finished to have a smooth, cleanable surface: EHS OBSERVED UNSEALED WOODEN BAGEL BOARDS WITH PARTIAL CLOTH COVERING USED TO COOK BAGELS NEAR OVENS.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be finished to have a smooth, easily cleanable surface. PIC WILL DISCONTINUE USE OF WOODEN BAGEL BOARDS. EHS RECOMMENDS OBTAINING METAL BAGEL BOARDS TO COOK BAGELS.
